propositions: Fourteen test modules hand-build nested pytest invocations with duplicated logic for basetemp, timeout, cache plugin and environment setup, creating maintenance burden and three prior closed bugs

A new run_nested_pytest helper in tests/_nested_pytest.py consolidates nested pytest launching with mandatory --basetemp, required verbatim env forwarding, optional cache-provider suppression, and keyword timeout passing
All 14 nested-pytest launch sites under tests/ must be converted to use the helper, with exactly one launch site remaining in the helper itself, verified by AST scan and definition-count guard
The helper must forward caller-supplied env dict byte-identically without merging onto os.environ, to preserve security-critical minimal-environment oracles in four test modules

Three specific test files (bare_repository_fixture_portability_heldout, git_version_floor, live_jira_xdist_confinement) currently lack --basetemp due to being integration/collect-only tests, creating live instances of shutdown-timeout defects
